findings.evidence: Its statement uses only `G.nsmulSeries p`, `G.heightFrobeniusIso hG` and `PowerSeries.subst`, and its proof rewrites only `heightFrobeniusIso_comp_iterateFrobeniusHom`, `iterateFrobeniusHom_toPowerSeries` and `nsmulHom_toPowerSeries` (Factorization.lean:173).
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/RingTheory/FormalGroup/Frobenius/Factorization.lean` as a public lemma, e.g. `FormalGroup.subst_nsmulSeries_eq_subst_pow_heightFrobeniusIso`, next to `heightFrobeniusIso_comp_iterateFrobeniusHom`, and use it from there.
findings.issue: `subst_nsmulSeries_eq_subst_pow` is `private`. It says `[p]_G(f) = ψ(f^(p^h))` for `ψ = G.heightFrobeniusIso hG`, a general consequence of `heightFrobeniusIso_comp_iterateFrobeniusHom` that does not depend on the classification argument. It is under-exposed general infrastructure.

findings.evidence: grep: the only use of `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_𝔾ₐ_smul_X_pow` is InfiniteHeight.lean:129. The new lemma's statement is `homogeneousComponent n (F.homDefect G (f + c • X^n) - F.homDefect G f) = c • (...)` for any `G`, including `𝔾ₐ`.
findings.fix: Delete `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_𝔾ₐ_smul_X_pow` and change its one caller (InfiniteHeight.lean:129) to use `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_add_sub (map_zero _)` with `homDefect_zero`/`zero_add`. Alternatively, keep it only as a one-line corollary proved from the general lemma.
findings.issue: The new general `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_add_sub` at `f = 0`, together with `homDefect_zero`, gives `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_𝔾ₐ_smul_X_pow` (same right-hand side `c • ((X 0 + X 1)^n - X 0^n - X 1^n)`). Both are public, so the API duplicates one fact.

summary: The general Frobenius-factorisation fact `[p]_G(f) = ψ(f^(p^h))` is hidden as `private` in the classification file instead of being exported next to `heightFrobeniusIso`. The new `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_add_sub` makes the existing `homogeneousComponent_homDefect_𝔾ₐ_smul_X_pow` a redundant special case.
